name: to-do
description: Date-routed daily to-do notes feeding SpaceDailyDashboard's tasks panel under spice/to-do/. v0.4.0 MINOR (v0.116.0): five-section daily-note shape (Capture / Carryover / Recurring / Project Groups / Unassigned Meetings). NEW Recurring Tasks registry at spice/to-do/Recurring Tasks.md (type: to-do-recurring) parsed on render and materialized into today's daily under ## Recurring Today. NEW per-project To-Do note shape (type: project-todo) at spice/projects/<slug>/<Name> To-Do.md (created by the project blueprint v1.22.0 backfill / extra_files). NEW tabbed +New Task dialog (ToDoCreateTask) with One-shot + Recurring modes. NEW palette commands sauce:new-task + sauce:new-recurring-task. NEW helpers: ToDoDailyCarryover (yesterday-only auto-migration into today's note), ToDoDailyRecurring (registry → today materializer), ToDoDailyProjectGroups (live aggregator over project To-Do notes + meeting tasks linked to projects), ToDoDailyUnassignedMeetings (live aggregator over meetings without project: frontmatter), TaskParser (parseTasks extracted from v0.3.3 ToDoMigrateModal), RecurrenceParser (pure recurrence-grammar evaluator covering 4 supported families: daily / weekday-set / day-of-month / every-N-weeks-on-day). RETIRED ToDoMigrateModal + ToDoMigrateInit (the Migrate-to-tomorrow modal is superseded by [scheduled:: YYYY-MM-DD] on the task line + the new tabbed dialog). depends_on +1 entity-create@>=0.5.0 (project list resolution at dialog open-time mirrors meetings@v0.8.0 options_source pattern). Two new schema-registry entries: project-todo (project blueprint-owned) + to-do-recurring (to-do blueprint-owned). Carries forward: v0.3.x All-ToDos hub + backlog aggregator + ToDoLeafActions self-heal posture (all retained; LeafActions extended to 3-button row).

post_install.message: To-do blueprint v0.4.0 installed at spice/to-do/. Daily To-Do note now has 5 sections (Capture / Carryover from yesterday / Recurring Today / Open Project Tasks / Meeting Tasks). NEW: spice/to-do/Recurring Tasks.md registry for recurring task templates. NEW per-project To-Do notes at spice/projects/<slug>/<Name> To-Do.md (scaffolded by the project blueprint backfill). Use the +New Task button or palette command 'Sauce: New task' to capture tasks. Use +Recurring or 'Sauce: New recurring task' for the registry. Migrate-to-tomorrow modal is retired; use [scheduled:: YYYY-MM-DD] instead.
